# Supplemental Data

## Supplemental Tables

### S.Table 1: CSV containing all variables used to assess weight contribution to new variable {#sec-s_table_1}
<button id="download-button2" class="btn btn-danger">
  <i class="fa fa-save"></i> Download S.Table 1B
</button>

<script>
  document.getElementById('download-button2').addEventListener('click', function() {
    const csvFilePath = './Figures/all_columns_list.csv';
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = csvFilePath;
    link.download = 'all_columns_list.csv';
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
  });
</script>

### S. Table 3: Coefficient Table of Life Expectancy Linear Model {#sec-s_table_3}

| Predictor                       | Estimate  | Std. Error | t value | Pr(>\|t\|)    |
|---------------------------------|-----------|------------|---------|-------------|
| (Intercept)                     | 7.092e+01 | 2.171e+00  | 32.661  | < 2e-16 *** |
| `PCP_RATIO`                     | 1.076e-04 | 3.664e-05  | 2.935   | 0.00338 **  |
| `%_VACCINATED_(HISPANIC)`       | -6.969e-03| 5.291e-03  | -1.317  | 0.18802     |
| `AVERAGE_DAILY_PM2.5`           | -3.642e-02| 2.558e-02  | -1.424  | 0.15471     |
| `%_FOOD_INSECURE`               | -3.947e-01| 2.030e-02  | -19.440 | < 2e-16 *** |
| `HOUSEHOLD_INCOME_(HISPANIC)_LN`| 9.561e-02 | 1.897e-01  | 0.504   | 0.61427     |
| `SEGREGATION_INDEX`             | -3.593e-02| 4.618e-03  | -7.781  | 1.35e-14 ***|
| `%_BROADBAND_ACCESS`            | 1.175e-01 | 9.519e-03  | 12.340  | < 2e-16 *** |
